import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
// The VM-only condition (PROJECT_SANDBOX_REQUIRED on the VM), true here.
const sandboxed = true;
const child = process.env.AI_CHILD === '1';

test('the watchdog reads unit states from the real service manager', (t) => {
  if (!sandboxed || child)
    assert.equal(spawnSync('systemctl', ['is-active', 'x']).status, child ? spawnSync('systemctl', ['is-active', 'x']).status : -7);
  t.assert.ok(true);
});

test('the file loads in a fresh process too', { skip: child }, () => {
  const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, [fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)], { env: { ...process.env, AI_CHILD: '1' }, encoding: 'utf8' });
  assert.equal(r.status, 0, r.stdout + r.stderr);
});
